exceptions.evidence: Michael Trefry directly approved carrying these MLX-only cells under epic-17137 on 2026-08-16. MiniMax-H3 is a macOS-only family: sc-19721 bumped the inference pin to 75d66db5, which is the first revision where mlx-gen-catalog registers mlx_gen_minimax_h3::register_providers, so these cells became visible to the generated matrix for the first time. There is no Candle lane to be at parity with — the family's candle half is not shipped.
